name: Install CutLoopz Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - cutloopz-production-test
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/install-cutloopz-release.yml
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: cutloopz-release-install
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  install:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/cutloopz-production-test'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout CutLoopz
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: true

      - name: Install account hub and avatar release
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
          from zipfile import ZipFile
          import tarfile, stat

          zip_name = Path('CUTLOOPZ_ONE_HUB_AVATAR_CROP_NOV14.zip')
          tar_name = Path('CUTLOOPZ_ONE_HUB_AVATAR_CROP_NOV14.tar.gz')
          prefix = 'Music-Video-Studio-cutloopz-production-test/'

          def safe_relative(name):
              if not name.startswith(prefix) or '\\' in name:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected release path')
              relative = PurePosixPath(name[len(prefix):])
              if not relative.parts or relative.is_absolute() or '..' in relative.parts:
                  raise SystemExit('Unsafe release path')
              return relative

          if zip_name.is_file():
              with ZipFile(zip_name) as archive:
                  entries = [item for item in archive.infolist() if not item.is_dir()]
                  names = [item.filename for item in entries]
                  if len(names) != len(set(names)):
                      raise SystemExit('Duplicate release paths')
                  if sum(item.file_size for item in entries) > 100_000_000:
                      raise SystemExit('Archive too large')
                  for item in entries:
                      if stat.S_IFMT(item.external_attr >> 16) == stat.S_IFLNK:
                          raise SystemExit('Symlink not permitted')
                  read = lambda entry: archive.read(entry)
                  install = [(item.filename, item) for item in entries]
                  def save_entries():
                      for name, item in install:
                          rel = safe_relative(name)
                          if rel.parts[0] in ('.git', '.github', 'tmp'):
                              continue
                          if rel.name.startswith('.env'):
                              raise SystemExit('Private config detected')
                          target = Path(*rel.parts)
                          target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                          target.write_bytes(read(item))
                      return set(names)
                  names_set = save_entries()
              zip_name.unlink()
          elif tar_name.is_file():
              with tarfile.open(tar_name, 'r:gz') as archive:
                  entries = archive.getmembers()
                  if not all(item.isfile() for item in entries):
                      raise SystemExit('Non-file archive member detected')
                  names = [item.name for item in entries]
                  if len(names) != len(set(names)):
                      raise SystemExit('Duplicate release paths')
                  if sum(item.size for item in entries) > 100_000_000:
                      raise SystemExit('Archive too large')
                  for item in entries:
                      rel = safe_relative(item.name)
                      if rel.parts[0] in ('.git', '.github', 'tmp'):
                          continue
                      if rel.name.startswith('.env'):
                          raise SystemExit('Private config detected')
                      target = Path(*rel.parts)
                      target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                      target.write_bytes(archive.extractfile(item).read())
                  names_set = set(names)
              tar_name.unlink()
          else:
              raise SystemExit('CutLoopz account hub / avatar release not uploaded')

          for required in ('server.js', 'package.json', 'public/index.html'):
              if prefix + required not in names_set:
                  raise SystemExit('Missing release file: ' + required)
          print('CutLoopz account hub and avatar release installed')
          PY

      - name: Validate Node server syntax
        run: node --check server.js

      - name: Commit installed website
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "Install CutLoopz account hub avatar [skip ci]"
            git push origin HEAD:cutloopz-production-test
          fi
